milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the cluster of solid yellow horn coral blocks placed at approximately (+5.5, +0.5, +5.5) relative to spawn. The target is the center of the 2x2 coral block cluster. max_distance=5.0 ensures the player must leave spawn and approach the coral reef zone; facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at the blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate past the horn coral block cluster to find the smaller horn coral fans (yellow plant shapes) placed at approximately (+9, +0, +5) to (+10, +0, +5) relative to spawn. Target is set to (9.0, 0.5, 5.5), the center of the horn coral fan cluster. max_distance=3.0 is intentionally tight to prevent overlap with the horn_coral_block milestone (whose target is 3.5 blocks away); combined with facing_tolerance=60, the player cannot simultaneously satisfy both milestones since facing one target means facing away from the other.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the opposite side of the scene (negative X/Z direction) to find the packed ice cluster (light blue-white blocks) placed at approximately (-6, +0, -5) to (-8, +0, -7) relative to spawn. Target (-7.0, 0.5, -6.0) is the center of the ice cluster. max_distance=5.0 requires the player to swim ~4+ blocks from spawn toward the ice; facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the ice blocks.
